description: The closure calendar for one exchange: full-day holidays (YYYY-MM-DD, exchange-local) and early-close days with their close times. A holiday or early close includes name when the exchange states one. calendar2027.status is official, estimated, or mixed. estimated means not yet published by the exchange; derived from its own past calendar; may change. Estimated replies start with that notice and mark each estimated date.

exchange.description: Exchange id (e.g. "nyse", "nasdaq", "lse", "nikkei", "hkex") OR common name/city (e.g. "New York Stock Exchange", "Tokyo", "London"). Case-insensitive.
